name: Past Paper
statement: Kam-chung uses 3 sheets of paper per day and Sze-hang uses 5 sheets of paper per day. They go to purchase a batch of 20 sheets of paper on the day they discover that there are not enough sheets for the next day. If Kam-chung and Sze-hang go to purchase together on the first day, on which day will they next to go to purchase together?
